Lemma. If a 6×6 array has two occurrences of each of three symbols in every row and column, and no 2×2 subarray contains a symbol exactly three times, then its rows can be partitioned into three pairs and its columns into three pairs so that every resulting 2×2 block is monochromatic. Two such 2-subsets cannot intersect in exactly one column: using their common column and one further column from each set would give a 2×2 subarray containing exactly three R's.
